name: Newfoundland and Labrador: consolidated statutes and regulations, change by change
label: Newfoundland and Labrador
record_note: Every statute the House of Assembly publishes in its consolidated statutes (550 acts, retrieved on 2026-10-28) and every regulation in its consolidated regulations (1829 regulations under regulations/, retrieved on 2026-10-29), with their point-in-time versions, checked version by version against the pages file by file and letter by letter. Point-in-time versions are not official copies (Statutes Act, RSNL1990 cS-26, s. 11(2)). Versions start at different days for different acts and regulations (most after 2006); 72 acts and 731 regulations are dated only by the retrieval day because the site gives no first day for their only version; 418 regulations never amended are dated by the filing day their page prints (Date-source: filed).

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: presumption against retrospectivity; immediate application to procedure
default_reach.meaning: an enactment is presumed not to apply to facts completed before it came into force, or to interfere with vested rights, unless the Legislature says so expressly or by necessary implication; procedural provisions apply immediately to pending matters; a repeal does not affect rights acquired or proceedings begun under the repealed enactment
default_reach.authority: Interpretation Act, RSNL1990 cI-19, s. 29 (effect of repeal); Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, s. 11(g) and 11(i); R. v. Dineley, 2012 SCC 58; Tran v. Canada (Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness), 2017 SCC 50

path_pattern: <chapter citation, e.g. SNL2015-cA-1.2 or RSNL1990-cH-3>/s<section>.md; front.md (title, chapter, long title, assent, enacting words); preamble.md; schedule-<x>.md; form-<x>.md; regulations/<regulation number, e.g. NLR-45-15, CNLR-1151-96 or NfldReg-11-98>/s<section>.md (front.md: number, title, filing, authority)
